title: AntiCheatReport
description: Per-game protection detection result combining local evidence (anti-cheat binaries on disk + packer/protector fingerprints in the game executable) with the named dataset. Drives the false-positive ban / launch-fail warning shown before any DLL-swap or DLSS override apply.

anticheat.description: Canonical protection name (e.g. 'Easy Anti-Cheat', 'BattlEye', 'Denuvo Anti-Tamper', 'VMProtect', 'Steam CEG DRM').

kind.description: Risk category: 'anti_cheat' = account-ban risk; 'anti_tamper' = launch-fail risk on signature mismatch (Denuvo/VMProtect/Themida/Arxan); 'drm' = store/launcher integrity, informational.

source.description: Evidence origin: 'binary' = anti-cheat binary filename found on disk; 'pe' = protector fingerprint in the parsed game executable; 'dataset' = matched the named dataset by Steam appid or normalized name.

status.description: Dataset Linux/Wine compatibility status when known (Running/Broken/Denied/Planned/Supported); null when only a local scan matched.

source_url.description: Learn-more link for the warning (per-game PCGamingWiki page when the Steam app id is known, else the PCGW glossary entry for the strongest detected kind).
